atan2_image — MV gray op

• Data kinds: image2d × image2d → image2d

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.atan2_image(image1, image2) (to call the implementation directly, import filters_arith; filters_arith.atan2_image(image1, image2); from the registry, opsmv.get("atan2_image"))

• HALCON equivalent: atan2_image (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Return the per-pixel atan2(image1, image2) of two images in radians.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

勾配の成分から向きを求めるのに使う。値は -pi .. pi。空の入力(image1 が 0 要素)は ValueError。
